profitabilityQualificationAudit.decisionCutoff: listing application/review in 2025; use pre-listing annual accounting evidence
profitabilityQualificationAudit.rule: Article 4 profitability requires one of: both last two years >=6%; last-two-year average >=6% with latest better; or each of last five years >=3%, plus the rule's other conditions.
profitabilityQualificationAudit.falsification: 2023 alone is below both 6% and 3%; the two-year average is below 6%. Therefore the special shorter profitable-issuer path is not supported by these pre-listing figures.
profitabilityQualificationAudit.qualificationCaveat: This is a bounded source-based qualification reconstruction, not a substitute for TWSE's issuer-specific review adjudication.

theoreticalReleaseSchedule.rule: 1/4 eligible after 6 months, another 1/4 each 6 months, full after 2 years, absent a separate TWSE exception.
theoreticalReleaseSchedule.criticalGuard: Eligibility dates are theoretical legal/replay states. They do not prove actual TWSE-approved release quantity or TDCC withdrawal.
